description: Finds presets: saved settings of a strategy for one instrument and chart timeframe. Each result has its preset_id, strategy, instrument, timeframe, a plain summary and, where published, its results: hypothetical TradingView Strategy Tester backtests by window, each with the link to its trade list (every trade behind the figures). It is the tool for finding and comparing presets; every filter is optional and filters combine, and with none it returns every preset available. Results are summaries without input values: get_preset returns one preset's every input, export_preset its files. Covers the free strategies' presets, plus a paid strategy's presets when the signed-in account holds its license. For a paid strategy without a license it returns no presets and a note with the strategy's page. Read-only.

instrument.description: Optional. A symbol or part of one, for example MNQ, MGC, XAUUSD or US100

strategy.description: Optional. A strategy_id or strategy name, matched ignoring case, spaces and dashes, for example tokyo-drift or Tokyo Drift

timeframe.description: Optional. A chart timeframe in minutes, for example 5m or 5 minutes

name: list_presets
title: List presets
